verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an extensive API (projects, experiments, datasets, logs, prompts, tools, scorers), a full-featured CLI (`bt`) for auth, tracing, evals, log queries, sync, and function management, and an MCP server letting agents query logs, author prompts/scorers, configure monitoring, and run evals — covering most core UI workflows programmatically. However, some UI-first surfaces (Playgrounds explicitly billed as 'no-code', custom annotation interfaces, Topics/Patterns configuration) lack clear documented API/CLI parity, and no public OpenAPI spec was discoverable (docs.md and openapi.json probes 404), leaving completeness unverified. Missing for 10: confirmed API/CLI equivalents for Playground-style real-time comparison and custom annotation-interface building, and a discoverable OpenAPI/API reference proving full UI parity, plus independent user corroboration.
